name: Topological Dilation
definition: A topological operation that expands the active region (narrow band) of a VDB grid by one voxel in all six directions by propagating the `mValueMask` bits from a LeafNode to its six immediate neighbors. It solves the problem of updating grid topology to track a moving interface without modifying voxel values.
summary: Topological Dilation expands a sparse voxel grid's active region by propagating topology bits to neighbors using compact bitwise operations on a single mask copy, avoiding redundant memory accesses.
